title: How Steep is the Phillips Curve in Developing Economies? A Sufficient Statistics Approach and Estimates for India
title_zh: 发展中国家菲利普斯曲线有多陡峭？一个充分统计量方法及对印度的估计
title_primary: 发展中国家菲利普斯曲线有多陡峭？一个充分统计量方法及对印度的估计
title_secondary: How Steep is the Phillips Curve in Developing Economies? A Sufficient Statistics Approach and Estimates for India
authors: Juan Herreño, Noémie Pinardon-Touati, Malte Thie
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We estimate the Phillips curve for India to shed light on the output-inflation tradeoff in developing economies. We develop a method to estimate the slope of the Phillips curve based on sufficient statistics that apply to a broad class of New Keynesian models. Using portable causal research designs, we estimate the firm-level passthrough of cost shocks into prices at different horizons, and the slope of marginal cost curves at different levels of aggregation. These empirical moments map into the slope of the Phillips curve and yield a decomposition into three terms: price rigidity, micro real rigidities, and macro real rigidities. The slope of the Phillips curve in India is one order of magnitude steeper than in the United States. This difference is explained by weaker macro real rigidities and less rigid prices. Extending the model to allow for input misallocation, we find that the re-allocative effects of monetary policy affect the Phillips curve, but this effect is small.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了印度的菲利普斯曲线，以揭示发展中经济体的产出-通胀权衡关系。我们开发了一种基于充分统计量的方法来估计菲利普斯曲线的斜率，该方法适用于广泛的新凯恩斯主义模型类别。利用便携式因果研究设计，我们估算了企业层面成本冲击在不同时间跨度上向价格的传导程度，以及不同聚合水平上边际成本曲线的斜率。这些经验矩映射到菲利普斯曲线的斜率，并分解为三个项：价格刚性、微观实际刚性和宏观实际刚性。印度的菲利普斯曲线斜率比美国陡峭一个数量级。这一差异归因于较弱的宏观实际刚性和较不刚性的价格。将模型扩展以允许投入错配，我们发现货币政策的再配置效应影响菲利普斯曲线，但这一效应较小。

title: The impact of election fraud on government performance
title_zh: 选举舞弊对政府绩效的影响
title_primary: 选举舞弊对政府绩效的影响
title_secondary: The impact of election fraud on government performance
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I examine how election fraud affects the type of government corruption and red tape that inhibit economic growth, as measured by building permit approvals in the Philippines, which are often delayed due to requests for bribes. To identify effects, I exploit a switch to automated elections in 2010 that made committing fraud more difficult. Estimates from a research design comparing changes over time in previously high-fraud and low-fraud towns indicate that automated elections significantly reduced election fraud, and that this led to a sharp and sustained 15 percent increase in the number of building permits approved annually. Local budget outcomes and priorities do not appear to be affected.
abstract_zh: 我研究了选举舞弊如何影响阻碍经济增长的政府腐败类型及官僚程序，以菲律宾建筑许可审批为衡量指标，这些审批常因索贿而延误。为识别因果效应，我利用了2010年转向自动化选举这一变化，该举措使舞弊行为更加困难。通过比较此前舞弊高发与低发城镇随时间变化的估计结果显示，自动化选举显著减少了选举舞弊，并由此导致每年获批建筑许可数量大幅且持续地增加了15%。地方预算结果和优先事项似乎未受影响。

title: Human-capital formation: The importance of endogenous longevity
title_zh: 人力资本形成：内生性寿命的重要性
title_primary: 人力资本形成：内生性寿命的重要性
title_secondary: Human-capital formation: The importance of endogenous longevity
authors: Titus J. Galama, Hans van Kippersluis
abstract: We present a theory of human capital, with health, skill, and longevity, endogenously determined. Using comparative dynamic analyses and a calibrated version of the theory, we uncover an important economic mechanism driving human-capital formation: whether individuals can influence their longevity. When they can, additional resources are invested in human capital. When they cannot, additional resources are used for consumption and leisure, i.e., “non-productively”. These findings point to the potential importance of endogenous longevity as an economic mechanism driving human-capital formation, and, by extension, human capital-based economic growth.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种人力资本理论，其中健康、技能和寿命均为内生决定。通过比较动态分析和理论校准版本，我们揭示了驱动人力资本形成的一个重要经济机制：个体能否影响自身寿命。当个体能够影响寿命时，额外资源被投资于人力资本；当不能时，额外资源则用于消费和休闲，即“非生产性”用途。这些发现指出了内生寿命作为驱动人力资本形成，进而推动基于人力资本的经济增长的经济机制，其潜在重要性不容忽视。

title: Robust Signal Maximization in Spillover Experiments
title_zh: 溢出效应实验中的稳健信号最大化
title_primary: 溢出效应实验中的稳健信号最大化
title_secondary: Robust Signal Maximization in Spillover Experiments
authors: Kirill Borusyak, Peter Hull, Evan Munro
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the optimal design and analysis of experiments for estimating spillover effects. Assuming a known (e.g., linear) exposure mapping, we characterize the treatment-assignment distribution and regression-based estimator that minimize worst-case asymptotic variance against a broad class of distributions of unobservables. The design problem yields an intuitive solution in which the planner trades off spillover signal strength against diffusion of spillover variation. The analysis problem yields a simple recentered instrumental variable estimator to best leverage this variation. This framework produces natural solutions in several benchmark cases—such as clustered exposure—and suggests computationally tractable approximations for general networks, including bipartite settings. We illustrate these new tools in semi-synthetic experiments based on two applications from development economics. Our approach yields large standard error reductions in both experiments, increasing effective sample sizes by 50–100% or more.
abstract_zh: 本文研究用于估计溢出效应的实验最优设计与分析方法。在已知（例如线性）暴露映射的假设下，我们刻画了能够最小化针对广泛不可观测变量分布的最坏情况渐近方差——该方差由处理分配分布与基于回归的估计量共同决定。设计问题给出了一个直观解：规划者需在溢出信号强度与溢出变异扩散之间进行权衡。分析问题则产生一个简单的中心化工具变量估计量，以最优方式利用该变异。该框架在若干基准情形（如聚类暴露）中提供了自然解，并为一般网络（包括二分图设定）提出了计算上可处理的近似方法。我们基于发展经济学的两个应用案例，通过半合成实验展示了这些新工具。在两个实验中，我们的方法均大幅降低了标准误，使有效样本量提升50%-100%或更多。

title: Knowledge Spillovers, Competition, and Individual Careers
title_zh: 知识溢出、竞争与个人职业生涯
title_primary: 知识溢出、竞争与个人职业生涯
title_secondary: Knowledge Spillovers, Competition, and Individual Careers
authors: Cornelissen, Thomas, Dustmann, Christian, Schönberg, Uta
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Exposure to better peers in the workplace can influence career trajectories through two opposing channels: positively, via knowledge spillovers, and negatively, through competition for advancement. We disentangle these effects by studying untrained labor market entrants and distinguishing between coworkers in the same occupation with whom they are likely to compete versus those with whom they are unlikely to compete. We find robust evidence of persistent knowledge spillovers but also identify countervailing competition effects of comparable magnitude. Both effects are more pronounced for men than for women.
abstract_zh: 接触更优秀的同事会通过两种相反的渠道影响职业发展轨迹：正向的知识溢出效应与负向的晋升竞争效应。通过研究未受训的劳动力市场新进入者，并区分同一职业中可能与之竞争的同事与不太可能与之竞争的同事，我们分离了这两种效应。研究发现了知识溢出效应的稳健持续性证据，同时也识别出规模相当的竞争抵消效应。这两种效应在男性群体中均比女性群体更为显著。

title: Development approaches for preventing violent extremism: A systematic review of the empirical evidence
title_zh: 预防暴力极端主义的发展路径：实证证据的系统综述
title_primary: 预防暴力极端主义的发展路径：实证证据的系统综述
title_secondary: Development approaches for preventing violent extremism: A systematic review of the empirical evidence
authors: Leanne M. Kelly, Greg Barton, Anthony Ware
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This systematic review examines English-language publications documenting primary-level community programming for preventing and countering violent extremism (P/CVE) undertaken by development civil society and non-government organisations (CSO/NGOs). The objective is to identify and critically analyse the strengths, problems, gaps, and opportunities in incorporating P/CVE into international and community development work. This focus is necessary because primary-level interventions target broad community resilience, unlike secondary and tertiary interventions, which focus on at-risk or radicalised individuals. Given that development CSOs working on P/CVE programs operate independently from government-led counterterrorism efforts, this review provides insights specific to non-securitised, community-level, development-driven approaches. Source inclusion parameters were set to require empirical studies on primary-level P/CVE programs run by development CSOs. Studies of secondary and tertiary interventions, government-led programs, and initiatives by educational or religious institutions were excluded to maintain the focus on non-state, community-level, development-driven approaches. There was no restriction on location, publication date, or publication type, with both peer-reviewed and grey-literature publications included. As the P/CVE field is relatively new, it was expected that the search would mostly find publications from the 2010s and 2020s, which proved to be the case, with the earliest publication being from 2008. Records were identified using Google Scholar, Google, JSTOR Security Studies, 3ie, ALNAP, OECD iLibrary, and institutional websites, with a final search occurring on 31 January 2024. Bias was assessed by recording authors’ affiliation with the evaluand (although internal evaluations were not excluded on that basis). Extracted data was analysed using grounded theory to inductively determine themes. The systematic review incorporates 129 studies reported in 137 papers: 64% qualitative, 32% mixed-methods, and 4% quantitative. Of these, 53% were industry and evaluation reports, 31% articles, 10% books/chapters, and 6% theses. Limitations include the heterogeneity of included studies and limited evaluation rigour, which constrain reliable conclusions of program effectiveness in many papers. Grounded analysis identified three overarching thematic groupings: interconnections, power and relations, and impact. Common findings across papers highlighted the opportunities for P/CVE programming to enhance the work already being conducted by development CSOs, although papers cautioned that this needs to be carefully designed, implemented, and assessed with consideration of context, objectives, appropriate terminology, local agency, sustainability, marginalised groups, and potential for perverse outcomes. The need for consistent, long-term, untied funding of development CSOs’ P/CVE programs was frequently raised, as was the importance of prioritising local participation in all aspects of programming. Many papers noted the value of effective coordination and collaboration horizontally between communities and CSOs as well as vertically between global and local authorities and academia. Evidence of effectiveness was heterogeneous, with some studies measuring impact and others measuring satisfaction. This likely underlies a particular problem with monitoring and evaluation in this nascent field rather than necessarily representing problematic programming. Key issues with monitoring and evaluation typically include unclear and infeasible theories of change, poor monitoring practices, and limited ability to conduct rigorous evaluation due to insufficient funding and capacity. The most promising practices centred on the evaluation of changes in knowledge, attitudes, social cohesion, and wellbeing. Rather than trying to evaluate the impact of a development program on a reduction in violent extremism, these evaluations demonstrated how P/CVE programs influenced the conditions that facilitate violent extremism and sought to enhance presumed protective factors. While the mechanisms that link these outcomes to P/CVE certainly require further investigation, there is evidence emerging that these preventative programs can strengthen individual and community resilience.
abstract_zh: 本系统综述梳理了以英文发表的、由发展型民间社会组织与非政府组织（CSO/NGO）实施的、旨在预防和应对暴力极端主义（P/CVE）的初级社区项目文献。研究目标在于识别并批判性分析将P/CVE纳入国际与社区发展工作的优势、问题、空白与机遇。之所以聚焦初级干预，是因为其针对的是广泛的社区韧性，而二级和三级干预则聚焦于高风险或已激进化个体。鉴于从事P/CVE项目的发展型CSO独立于政府主导的反恐行动，本综述提供了针对非安全化、社区层面、发展驱动型方法的独特见解。文献纳入标准要求必须包含发展型CSO实施的初级P/CVE项目的实证研究。为保持对非国家、社区层面、发展驱动型方法的聚焦，排除了二级和三级干预、政府主导项目以及教育或宗教机构倡议的研究。研究未对地点、发表年份或发表类型设限，同行评审文献与灰色文献均纳入分析。由于P/CVE领域相对新兴，预期搜索结果主要来自2010年代和2020年代——事实确如此，最早文献发表于2008年。通过Google Scholar、Google、JSTOR Security Studies、3ie、ALNAP、OECD iLibrary及机构网站检索记录，最终检索日期为2024年1月31日。通过记录作者与被评估对象的隶属关系评估偏倚（但内部评估未因此被排除）。采用扎根理论对提取数据进行归纳性主题分析。本系统综述纳入129项研究（报告于137篇论文中）：64%为定性研究，32%为混合方法研究，4%为定量研究。其中53%为行业与评估报告，31%为期刊文章，10%为书籍/章节，6%为学位论文。局限性包括纳入研究的异质性及评估严谨性不足，这导致许多论文中关于项目有效性的可靠结论受限。扎根分析识别出三大主题群：相互关联性、权力与关系、影响。论文中的共同发现凸显了P/CVE项目增强发展型CSO现有工作的机遇，但论文也警示需结合情境、目标、恰当术语、地方能动性、可持续性、边缘群体及潜在负面后果进行审慎设计、实施与评估。发展型CSO的P/CVE项目需要持续、长期、无附加条件的资金支持这一诉求被频繁提及，同时强调在项目各环节优先保障地方参与的重要性。许多论文指出，社区与CSO之间的横向协调合作，以及全球与地方当局及学术界之间的纵向协作具有重要价值。有效性证据呈现异质性：部分研究测量影响，部分则测量满意度。这很可能反映了这一新兴领域监测评估中的特定问题，而非必然代表项目设计缺陷。监测评估的关键问题通常包括：变革理论不清晰且不可行、监测实践薄弱、因资金与能力不足导致严格评估受限。最具前景的实践聚焦于知识、态度、社会凝聚力与福祉变化的评估。这些评估并非试图衡量发展项目对减少暴力极端主义的影响，而是展示P/CVE项目如何影响助长暴力极端主义的条件，并致力于增强假定的保护性因素。尽管将这些结果与P/CVE关联的机制仍需进一步探究，但已有证据表明，这些预防性项目能够增强个体与社区的韧性。

title: Shadow Activity and Unemployment in a Depressed Labour Market
title_zh: 萧条劳动力市场中的影子活动与失业
title_primary: 萧条劳动力市场中的影子活动与失业
title_secondary: Shadow Activity and Unemployment in a Depressed Labour Market
authors: Tito Boeri, Pietro Garibaldi, Alexia Delfino, Andrea Garnero, Sergio Inferrera 等
official: 官方在线 2002-06-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This Paper studies the border between shadow employment and unemployment. It argues that the two macroeconomic phenomena are two faces of the same coin: any policy aimed at reducing the former will increase the latter. Theoretically, it proposes and solves a matching model of the labour market, where shadow employment emerges in equilibrium as the endogenous response of firms and workers who felt overburdened by taxes and regulations. While the model we propose neatly rationalizes the labour market trade-off implied by ?shadow reducing policies?, it suggests that economies with low unemployment turnover should be characterized also by low turnover along the shadow margins. Since existing estimates of shadow employment are silent on labour market flows and on the relation between shadow activity and the main labour market aggregates, we perform original empirical work on the border between employment, unemployment and inactivity, and we find that Italian shadow employment has longer duration in regions with lower unemployment turnover. We also find support to the substantive assumptions of the model.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了影子就业与失业之间的边界。研究认为，这两种宏观经济现象是同一枚硬币的两面：任何旨在减少前者的政策都将导致后者的增加。在理论层面，本文提出并求解了一个劳动力市场的匹配模型，在该模型中，影子就业作为企业和工人因税收与监管负担过重而产生的内生反应，在均衡状态下出现。尽管我们提出的模型清晰地解释了“减少影子政策”所隐含的劳动力市场权衡关系，但它也表明，失业流动率较低的经济体，其影子就业边际的流动率也应较低。由于现有对影子就业的估算并未涉及劳动力市场流动以及影子活动与主要劳动力市场总量之间的关系，我们针对就业、失业与非经济活动之间的边界开展了原创性实证研究，并发现意大利影子就业在失业流动率较低的地区持续时间更长。此外，我们还找到了支持模型实质性假设的证据。

title: Was Javert Right to Be Suspicious? Marginal Treatment Effects with Duration Outcomes
title_zh: 贾维特的怀疑是对的吗？持续期结果下的边际处理效应
title_primary: 贾维特的怀疑是对的吗？持续期结果下的边际处理效应
title_secondary: Was Javert Right to Be Suspicious? Marginal Treatment Effects with Duration Outcomes
authors: Santiago Acerenza, Vitor Possebom, Pedro H. C. Sant’Anna
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We identify the distributional and quantile marginal treatment effect functions when the outcome is right-censored. Our method requires a conditionally exogenous instrument and random censoring. We propose asymptotically consistent semi-parametric estimators and valid inferential procedures for the target functions . To illustrate, we evaluate the effect of alternative sentences (fines and community service vs. no punishment) on recidivism in Brazil. Our results highlight substantial treatment effect heterogeneity: we find that people whom most judges would punish take longer to recidivate, while people who would be punished only by strict judges recidivate at an earlier date than if they were not punished.
abstract_zh: 我们识别了当结果存在右删失时的分布和分位数边际处理效应函数。该方法要求工具变量条件外生且删失随机。我们提出了目标函数的渐近一致半参数估计量及有效推断程序。为进行说明，我们评估了巴西替代性刑罚（罚金与社区服务 vs. 无惩罚）对再犯率的影响。研究结果凸显了显著的处理效应异质性：多数法官倾向于施以惩罚的个体再犯间隔时间更长，而仅被严厉法官判处惩罚的个体，其再犯时间反而早于未受惩罚的情况。

title: M&As, Employee Costs, and Labor Reallocation
title_zh: 并购、员工成本与劳动力再配置
title_primary: 并购、员工成本与劳动力再配置
title_secondary: M&As, Employee Costs, and Labor Reallocation
abstract: Mergers are associated with large and persistent earnings declines for incumbent employees in target firms. Linking employer‐employee administrative data with information on merger activity in Brazil, I find the negative effects concentrate on employees who exit target firms and reflect displacement in the short run and wage declines in the long run. Low‐skilled, managerial, and older employees fare worse. Overall, I conclude that mergers are followed by substantial reallocation costs reflecting losses of firm‐specific wage premiums, matching inefficiencies, and industry‐specific human capital depreciation, with employees transitioning to lower paying firms considered to be of lower productivity and employment value.
abstract_zh: 并购与目标企业现有员工的大幅且持续的收入下降相关。通过将巴西雇主-雇员行政数据与并购活动信息相关联，我发现负面效应主要集中在离职的目标企业员工身上，这既反映了短期内的岗位流失，也体现了长期内的工资下降。低技能、管理岗位及年长员工受到的影响更为严重。总体而言，我得出结论：并购之后会出现显著的重新配置成本，这反映了企业特定工资溢价的损失、匹配效率低下以及行业特定人力资本的贬值，员工转而流向被认为生产率和就业价值较低的低薪企业。

title: Do economic principles explain orbital use in space?
title_zh: 经济原理能否解释太空轨道利用？
title_primary: 经济原理能否解释太空轨道利用？
title_secondary: Do economic principles explain orbital use in space?
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: While the global space economy continues to rapidly grow, and public policy challenges related to satellites and debris in orbit emerge, there is surprisingly little evidence connecting theoretical economic frameworks with observed orbital usage. Using a state-of-the-science integrated assessment model combining economic modeling with physical models of the space environment, we find the observed distribution of satellite orbits is well-explained by profit-maximizing satellite operator behavior. Furthermore, we find strong evidence that collision risk plays a key deterrence role. Finally, the observed location of the largest satellite constellation, Starlink, is consistent with a “sole owner” over particularly economically desirable altitudes.
abstract_zh: 全球太空经济继续快速增长，与轨道卫星和碎片有关的公共政策挑战不断显现，但将理论经济学框架与实际轨道使用联系起来的证据却出人意料地稀少。本文使用一个结合经济模型与太空环境物理模型的前沿综合评估模型，发现观测到的卫星轨道分布可以由卫星运营商利润最大化行为很好地解释。进一步结果表明，碰撞风险发挥了重要的威慑作用。最后，最大卫星星座 Starlink 的实际部署位置，与其在经济价值尤其高的轨道高度上表现为“单一所有者”的行为相一致。

title: Perseverance, cognitive skills and life outcomes
title_zh: 毅力、认知技能与人生结果
title_primary: 毅力、认知技能与人生结果
title_secondary: Perseverance, cognitive skills and life outcomes
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the early-life determinants of children’s perseverance and its predictive power for educational attainment and labour market outcomes across the life course. Using teacher-assessed perseverance from the 1970 British Cohort Study we document that cognitive skills, gender, early health, and parental influences (particularly maternal biological factors and paternal education) are the strongest predictors of perseverance at age 10. Perseverance and cognitive skills exhibit distinct yet complementary effects on later outcomes. Perseverance shows strong associations with academic self-perception, internal locus of control, and interpersonal workplace skills such as teamwork, while cognitive skills dominate in technical and numerical domains. We assess the credibility of these associations, by combining Augmented Inverse Propensity Weighting with the framework of Cinelli and Hazlett (2020), quantifying how strong unobserved confounding would need to be to overturn our findings. This analysis reveals that perseverance’s associations with contemporaneous academic performance and locus of control beliefs show strong to moderate robustness. In contrast, associations with educational attainment and labour market outcomes are more fragile. Subgroup analysis reveals that perseverance functions as a compensatory mechanism in the face of childhood adversity, and it reinforces effort beliefs and labour market outcomes for males. Our findings would imply that policies promoting perseverance yield credible benefits for academic engagement and psychological well-being, but long-term economic gains requires interventions addressing educational access, financial barriers and labour market inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了儿童早期坚持性的决定因素及其在生命历程中对教育成就和劳动力市场结果的预测力。利用1970年英国队列研究中教师评估的坚持性，我们记录了认知技能、性别、早期健康以及父母影响（尤其是母亲生物学因素和父亲教育程度）是10岁时坚持性的最强预测因子。坚持性与认知技能在后续结果上表现出独特且互补的效应。坚持性与学术自我认知、内在控制点以及人际工作场所技能（如团队合作）密切相关，而认知技能在技术和数值领域占主导地位。我们通过将增强逆概率加权与Cinelli和Hazlett（2020）的框架相结合，评估了这些关联的可信度，量化了未观测混杂因素需要多强才能推翻我们的发现。分析显示，坚持性与同期学业表现和控制点信念的关联表现出强至中等的稳健性。相比之下，与教育成就和劳动力市场结果的关联则较为脆弱。亚组分析揭示，坚持性在面对童年逆境时起到补偿机制的作用，并强化了男性的努力信念和劳动力市场结果。我们的发现意味着，促进坚持性的政策对学术参与和心理健康产生可信的益处，但长期经济收益需要干预措施来解决教育机会、财务障碍和劳动力市场不平等问题。

title: Fiscal demographic reversal
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how rising longevity affects the long-run real interest rate in an overlapping-generations model with mortality risk and accidental bequests to the young. Longer lives increase retirement saving, which tends to lower the interest rate, but they also reduce such bequests and shift asset payoffs from young savers to surviving retirees, weakening aggregate saving. Public debt amplifies this second force. When debt is sufficiently high, further increases in longevity eventually raise the steady-state interest rate. Thus, longevity need not continue to depress interest rates: with large public debt, the relationship between longevity and the interest rate becomes non-monotonic. • We study the longevity–interest rate relationship in an OLG model with accidental bequests. • Longevity raises saving but reduces accidental bequests to the young. • Public debt amplifies the decline in bequests and shifts asset payoffs. • High public debt can make the relationship U-shaped.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在包含死亡风险和向年轻人意外遗赠的交叠世代模型中，寿命延长如何影响长期实际利率。更长的寿命增加了退休储蓄，这倾向于降低利率，但同时也减少了此类遗赠，并将资产收益从年轻储蓄者转移至存活的退休者，从而削弱了总体储蓄。公共债务放大了这第二种力量。当债务足够高时，寿命的进一步延长最终会提高稳态利率。因此，寿命延长未必持续压低利率：在公共债务庞大的情况下，寿命与利率之间的关系变为非单调的。• 我们在包含意外遗赠的OLG模型中研究了寿命与利率的关系。• 寿命延长提高了储蓄，但减少了对年轻人的意外遗赠。• 公共债务加剧了遗赠的减少并转移了资产收益。• 高公共债务可使该关系呈U形。

title: Water mills and human capital accumulation in industrializing Prussia
title_zh: 水磨与工业化时期普鲁士的人力资本积累
title_primary: 水磨与工业化时期普鲁士的人力资本积累
title_secondary: Water mills and human capital accumulation in industrializing Prussia
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Did Germany’s industrial rise begin with its water mills? This study examines how water mills shaped early industrial development in Prussia using historical county-level census data. I show that water-powered proto-industrialization fostered skilled artisanal human capital by the mid-nineteenth century. Unlike wind or animal-powered mills, water mills supported diverse industries, driving technological spillovers and early industrialization. Counties with more water mills saw faster population growth, though this effect declined with the adoption of coal and steam. These findings underscore water power’s role in Germany’s industrial rise, and suggest that water-driven industrialization was a broader European phenomenon, not unique to Britain.
abstract_zh: 德国的工业崛起是否始于其水力磨坊？本研究利用历史县级人口普查数据，探讨了水力磨坊如何塑造普鲁士早期工业发展。我证明，至十九世纪中叶，以水为动力的原始工业化促进了熟练手工业人力资本的形成。与风力或畜力磨坊不同，水力磨坊支撑了多样化的产业，推动了技术溢出与早期工业化。拥有更多水力磨坊的县经历了更快的人口增长，尽管这一效应随着煤炭和蒸汽的采用而减弱。这些发现强调了水力在德国工业崛起中的作用，并表明水驱动的工业化是更广泛的欧洲现象，并非英国独有。

title: Racial disparities in crime and wealth
title_zh: 犯罪与财富中的种族差异
title_primary: 犯罪与财富中的种族差异
title_secondary: Racial disparities in crime and wealth
authors: Ayşe İmrohoroğlu, Çağrı S. Kumru, Jiu Lian
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper documents how racial differences in labor income may simultaneously explain both crime and wealth disparities between Black and White individuals. Using an overlapping generations model that endogenously determines crime rates alongside consumption and savings decisions, we find that equalizing labor incomes results in a significant decline in both the Black crime rate and the proportion of Black individuals in the lowest wealth quintile. Higher crime and incarceration rates of Black individuals, on the other hand, do not significantly contribute to their low wealth. This is primarily because most crimes are committed by already poor and young individuals who are not saving in any case.
abstract_zh: 本文档记录了劳动收入中的种族差异如何可能同时解释黑人与白人个体之间的犯罪率和财富差距。通过使用一个内生决定犯罪率以及消费和储蓄决策的重叠世代模型，我们发现，使劳动收入均等化会导致黑人犯罪率和处于最低财富五分位的黑人比例显著下降。另一方面，黑人个体较高的犯罪率和监禁率并未显著促成其低财富水平。这主要是因为大多数犯罪由本已贫困且年轻、无论如何都不储蓄的个体实施。

title: The business cycle state‐dependent effects of tax news: A joint‐state analysis
title_zh: 税收新闻的商业周期状态依赖效应：联合状态分析
title_primary: 税收新闻的商业周期状态依赖效应：联合状态分析
title_secondary: The business cycle state‐dependent effects of tax news: A joint‐state analysis
abstract: This paper examines how the interaction of business cycles with the source of fluctuations and macroeconomic uncertainty shapes the impact of tax news on output. Using tax news from the municipal bond market and a smooth transition local projection, we find anticipated tax cuts are more contractionary in supply-driven than demand-driven recessions, and in high-uncertainty than low-uncertainty recessions. High market congestion in supply-driven recessions and elevated real option values in high-uncertainty recessions contribute to these stronger contractionary effects. The findings suggest that countercyclical tax policies may have unintended impacts during anticipation periods, depending on business cycle sources and uncertainty levels.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了商业周期与波动来源及宏观经济不确定性之间的相互作用如何影响税收新闻对产出的效应。利用市政债券市场的税收新闻及平滑转换局部投影法，我们发现，预期中的减税在供给驱动型衰退中比在需求驱动型衰退中更具紧缩性，在高不确定性衰退中比在低不确定性衰退中更具紧缩性。供给驱动型衰退中的高市场拥挤度及高不确定性衰退中上升的真实期权价值，共同导致了这些更强的紧缩效应。研究结果表明，逆周期税收政策在预期期间可能产生非预期影响，其效果取决于商业周期的来源及不确定性水平。
